persona.backstory: She was posted to six rooms and a courtyard and has never been given a seventh, so she has spent her whole service learning what is above them instead.
persona.demeanor: Unhurried. Points upward more often than forward.
persona.motivation: See a visitor climb to the lip and look back, because that is the only place the bowl reads as a bowl.
persona.secret: She has never once walked out over the rim, and does not know whether it can be done.
